description: 1. Agent discovers the SKILL.md at /root/clawd/skills/meihua-yishu/SKILL.md and reads the algorithm: upper=hour%8 (0→8), lower=minute%8 (0→8), yao=(hour+minute)%6 (0→6). 2. Agent reads the CSV at client_records/2024/Q4/batch_consultations.csv and identifies 10 valid rows (C001–C010) and 5 malformed rows (C011–C015) that must be skipped. 3. For each valid session, agent invokes `node /root/clawd/skills/meihua-yishu/scripts/meihua.js [YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM]` (the proprietary invocation from SKILL.md) and parses upper/lower/yao from stdout. 4. CRITICAL TRAP: The agent must NOT naively use Python modulo that returns 0 — the proprietary rule requires substituting 0 with the maximum (8 for trigrams, 6 for yao). Sessions C001 (yao trap), C002 (lower trap), C003 (upper trap), C004 (both upper+lower trap), C008 (all three trap) specifically test this. 5. Agent writes divination_report.json containing all 10 valid sessions with correct upper_trigram, lower_trigram, and moving_line/yao integer values.
